```{r age-mods}
#| dependson: load-scores

# remove CAT data, remove CO data from memory task
fixed_only <- coretask_scores |>
  filter(!adaptive) #|>
  # filter(!(task == "Memory" & site_label == "uniandes-co")) |> # drop CO Memory
  # mutate(age_c = age - mean(age))
contrasts(fixed_only$site_label) <- contr.sum(nlevels(fixed_only$site_label))

age_mods <- fixed_only |>
  nest(scores = -contains("task")) |>
  mutate(scores = map(scores, \(s) s |> mutate(score = scale(score)[,1]))) |>
  mutate(score_age_mod = map(scores, \(s) lm(score ~ age * site_label, data = s)))

age_seq <- seq(min(fixed_only$age), max(fixed_only$age), length.out = 100)
sites_grid <- \(s) {
  datagrid(site_label = s,
           age = age_seq,
           newdata = fixed_only) |>
    select(site_label, age) |>
    droplevels()
}

age_preds <- age_mods |>
  mutate(sites = map(scores, \(sc) unique(sc$site_label)),
         pred_grid = map(sites, sites_grid),
         preds = map2(score_age_mod, pred_grid, \(mod, pg) predictions(mod, newdata = pg) |> as_tibble())) |>
  select(contains("task"), preds) |>
  unnest(preds)
```

```{r age-slopes}
#| dependson: age-slopes

age_slopes <- age_mods |>
  mutate(
    slope = map(score_age_mod, \(mod) {
      avg_slopes(mod, variable = "age") |> as_tibble()
    }),
    slope_dataset = map(score_age_mod, \(mod) {
      avg_slopes(mod, variable = "age", by = "site_label") |> as_tibble()
    })
  )

age_slopes_df <- full_join(
  age_slopes |> select(-scores, -score_age_mod, -slope_dataset) |> unnest(slope) |> mutate(site_label = "overall"),
  age_slopes |> select(-scores, -score_age_mod, -slope) |> unnest(slope_dataset)
) |>
  mutate(site_label = factor(site_label, levels = c("overall", names(site_labels)))) |>
  arrange(site_label, estimate) |>
  mutate(task = task |> fct_inorder())

age_slope_diffs <- age_mods |>
  mutate(
    slope_diff = map(score_age_mod, \(mod) {
      avg_slopes(mod, variable = "age", by = "site_label",
                 hypothesis = difference ~ meandev) |> as_tibble()
    })
  )

age_slope_diffs_df <- age_slope_diffs |>
  select(-scores, -score_age_mod) |>
  unnest(slope_diff) |>
  mutate(signif = p.value < 0.05) |> # TODO: multcomp?
  mutate(site_label = hypothesis |> str_remove(" - Mean") |> str_remove_all("[\\(\\)]") |>
           factor(levels = c("overall", names(site_labels))),
         .after = hypothesis)

age_slopes_overall <- age_slopes_df |> filter(site_label == "overall")
age_slopes_dataset <- age_slopes_df |>
  filter(site_label != "overall") |>
  left_join(age_slope_diffs_df |> select(item_task, site_label, signif))
```

```{r age-cors}
#| dependson: age-slopes

age_cors_dataset <- fixed_only |>
  nest(data = -c(task, site_label)) |>
  mutate(n = map_int(data, nrow),
         cor_test = map(data, \(d) cor.test(~ score + age, data = d) |> broom::tidy())) |>
  select(task, site_label, cor_test, n) |>
  unnest(cor_test)

age_cors_overall <- fixed_only |>
  nest(data = -c(task)) |>
  mutate(n = map_int(data, nrow),
         cor_test = map(data, \(d) cor.test(~ score + age, data = d) |> broom::tidy())) |>
  select(task, cor_test, n) |>
  unnest(cor_test) |>
  mutate(site_label = "overall")

age_cors_df <- bind_rows(age_cors_overall, age_cors_dataset)
```

```{r age-stats}
age_stats_tbl <- list(
  "cor" = age_cors_df |> select(task, site_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, n),
  "slope" = age_slopes_df |> select(task, site_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "stat") |>
  mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), \(x) sprintf("%.2f", x))) |>
  mutate(est_ci = glue("{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}]")) |>
  select(stat, task, site_label, n, est_ci) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = c(n, est_ci)) |>
  select(-n_slope) |>
  mutate(site_label = site_label |> as_factor() |> fct_relevel("overall") |> fct_recode("–" = "overall")) |>
  relocate(est_ci_slope, .before = est_ci_cor) |>
  arrange(task, site_label) |>
  mutate(task = if_else(task == lag(task) & !is.na(lag(task)), "", task))
```
